description: Makes a new table in the site's connected Supabase project, the same way as Add table in Xodia's Database view (Content, Database): the fields you list plus id and created_at, row rules always on with one of seven rules (see rule) for who can see and change entries, and a migration file in supabase/migrations/ on the branch so the change shows in Site code and git. Changes the user's live database at once, outside Xodia's Versions: say what you are adding before you call it. Pick the rule from what the owner asked; when it is unclear, ask, and use "owner_only" until they say. For what visitors read and only the owner fills (a menu, a price list, opening hours, a team list), use "everyone_reads_owner_writes": no form on the site can add to it, and the owner adds and changes its entries in Xodia's Database view (Content, Database) (no tool adds entries). For entries the owner keeps for one signed-in person each (a client's project and its milestones), use "own_rows_read_owner_writes" with fullAccessRole "owner": each person sees only the entries whose created_by is them and nobody changes them from the site. Refused when a table or field name is taken (pick another), for kinds Xodia doesn't add, and when the site has no database connected. No tool deletes or renames a table or field, deletes entries, or runs SQL: the owner does that in Xodia's Database view (Content, Database).

branch.description: Optional branch for the migration file; default the branch the workspace has open

fields.description: The table's own fields. Every table also gets id and created_at (and created_by for the rules that track who added an entry): don't list those

kind.description: The kind of field: "text" (Text), "number" (Number), "yes_no" (Yes or no), "date" (Date), "date_time" (Date and time), "link" (Link to another table)

linkTo.description: For kind "link": the table it points at (its single ID field is used)

name.description: The field's name: letters, numbers, spaces and underscores, starting with a letter (it is stored lower case with underscores: "Guest count" becomes guest_count)

required.description: true: every new entry must give it. Default false

fullAccessRole.description: Optional, beside any rule: people with a role can see and change everything (a role name such as "owner" or "staff", read from the person's app metadata like the data kit's HasRole). Only when the user asks for it

name.description: The table's name: letters, numbers, spaces and underscores, starting with a letter (it is stored lower case with underscores: "Guest count" becomes guest_count)

rule.description: Who can see and change entries: "everyone_reads_signed_in_adds" (Everyone sees, signed-in people add: Anyone can see entries. People who are signed in can add new ones and change their own.); "everyone_reads_owner_writes" (Everyone sees, only you change: Anyone can see entries. Nobody can add or change them from the site. You add and change them in Xodia.); "own_rows_only" (Each person sees only their own: Signed-in people see and change only the entries they added.); "own_rows_read_owner_writes" (Each person sees their own, only the owner changes: Signed-in people see only the entries kept for them. Nobody adds or changes them from the site. You add and change them in Xodia.); "signed_in_reads_own_writes" (Signed-in people see everyone's, each changes only their own: People who are signed in see every entry. Each of them adds and changes only their own.); "signed_in_only" (Signed-in people only: Only people who are signed in can see, add and change entries.); "owner_only" (Only you: Visitors can't see or change entries. You manage them in Xodia.)

name: create_table
title: Create a database table
